features.name: Upload
steps: Upload the provided bird.png file to the root of Dropbox and verify that it appears exactly once in All files.
features.expected: File must appear exactly once in All files after upload.

features.name: Upload
steps: Upload the provided bird.png, report.pdf, and notes.txt files in one operation and verify that all three files appear with the correct filenames.
features.expected: All three files must appear with correct filenames after a single operation.

features.name: New folder
steps: Create a private folder named Project Alpha and verify that it appears in All files.
features.expected: New folder must appear in All files.

features.name: New folder
steps: Create the hierarchy Projects / Alpha / Assets and verify that each folder exists at the correct nesting level.
features.expected: Nested folders must exist at the correct levels (Projects / Alpha / Assets).

features.name: Move
steps: Move report.pdf from the root into Projects / Alpha and verify that it no longer appears at the root.
features.expected: Moved file must no longer appear at the root.

features.name: Move
steps: Select four specified files and move all of them into Projects / Alpha / Assets in one operation. Verify that all four files changed location and no unrelated files moved.
features.expected: All four files must move in one operation; no unrelated files move.

features.name: Copy
steps: Copy notes.txt into Projects / Alpha while preserving the original file at the root. Verify that both copies exist.
features.expected: Both the original and copied file must exist after copy.

features.name: Rename
steps: Rename notes.txt to meeting-notes.txt and rename Project Alpha to Project Phoenix. Verify that the renamed file remains inside the renamed folder structure.
features.expected: Renames must apply correctly; the renamed file stays inside the renamed folder structure.

features.name: Download
steps: Download report.pdf and verify that the downloaded file retains the original filename.
features.expected: Downloaded file must retain the original filename.

features.name: Search
steps: Search for meeting-notes and use the available file-type filter so that the intended text file is the only matching result.
features.expected: Search with type filter must return only the intended text file.

features.name: Search
steps: Search only within Project Phoenix for files with the .png extension and verify that files outside that folder are excluded from the results.
features.expected: Folder-scoped search must exclude files outside the folder.

features.name: Recent
steps: Open bird.png, return to All files, activate Recent, and verify that the recently opened image is surfaced without changing the file itself.
features.expected: Recently opened image must surface in Recent without changing the file.

features.name: Star
steps: Star bird.png and the Project Phoenix folder, then use the Starred filter and verify that both objects are shown.
features.expected: Both starred objects must appear in the Starred filter.

features.name: Star
steps: Remove the star from bird.png while keeping Project Phoenix starred. Verify that only the folder remains in the Starred view.
features.expected: Only the folder remains starred after removing the star from the file.

features.name: Type / Extension
steps: Use the Type and Extension filters to show only PNG image files from a mixed collection of images, documents, and folders.
features.expected: Type/Extension filters must show only PNG files from a mixed collection.

features.name: Photos
steps: Open Photos, display only photos from the target month, and verify that non-image documents from the same month do not appear.
features.expected: Photos view must show only target-month photos; non-image documents do not appear.

features.name: Photos / Starred
steps: Star a specified photo from Photos, switch to the Starred photo filter, and verify that the selected photo appears there without being moved from its original folder.
features.expected: Starred photo must appear in the Starred photo filter without being moved.

features.name: Delete / Deleted files
steps: Delete report.pdf, confirm that it disappears from its folder, restore it from Deleted files, and verify that it returns to its original location.
features.expected: Deleted file must disappear, then restore to its original location from Deleted files.

features.name: Delete / Deleted files
steps: Delete the folder Project Phoenix containing multiple nested files, restore the folder from Deleted files, and verify that its hierarchy and contents are restored.
features.expected: Deleted folder must restore with its full hierarchy and contents.

features.name: Set naming convention
steps: Configure a naming convention for a folder that includes the upload date, then verify that files in the folder follow the configured date-based naming structure.
features.expected: Files must follow the configured date-based naming structure.

features.name: Set naming convention
steps: Configure a folder naming convention that combines an upload-date component with the keyword ARCHIVE, and verify that the resulting filenames follow the configured component order.
features.expected: Filenames must follow the configured component order (date + ARCHIVE).

features.name: Add automation
steps: Create an automated folder named Processed that applies a deterministic rename rule to newly added files. Add a fixture file and verify that the resulting filename follows the automation rule.
features.expected: Newly added files must follow the automation's rename rule.

features.name: Add automation
steps: Add an automation to an existing folder that converts supported uploaded documents to PDF. Add the provided invoice.docx fixture and verify that the resulting PDF is created in the expected folder.
features.expected: Uploaded document must be converted to PDF in the expected folder.

features.name: Add automation
steps: Create an automated folder with two sequential steps: apply a filename rule containing ARCHIVE, then convert supported documents to PDF. Add invoice.docx and verify that both transformations are reflected in the final result.
features.expected: Both sequential steps (rename with ARCHIVE, convert to PDF) must be reflected in the final result.

features.name: Add automation
steps: Configure an automation on a parent folder, create a new subfolder inside it, add a compatible fixture file to the subfolder, and verify that the inherited automation is applied.
features.expected: Inherited automation must apply to files added in the subfolder.

features.name: Crop
steps: Open bird.png, use Crop with explicit custom dimensions, save the edited image as a new copy named bird-cropped.png, and verify that the original remains unchanged.
features.expected: Cropped copy must be saved as bird-cropped.png; the original remains unchanged.

features.name: Rotate left / Save a copy
steps: Open bird.png, rotate it 90 degrees to the left, save the result as bird-rotated.png, and verify that both the original and rotated copy exist.
features.expected: Both original and rotated copy (bird-rotated.png) must exist after rotation.

features.name: All files / Organize
steps: Build Archive / 2026 / Images, move three specified images into the final folder, rename one file, star another, delete and restore the third, then verify the final hierarchy and the state of all three files.
features.expected: Final hierarchy must match the target structure; the renamed, starred, and restored files must all be in the correct states.
